verdict.rationale: Linear is a product-planning tool, so a customer-facing changelog with email subscriptions is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented capability for this. The changelog citations are Linear's own release notes, not a feature that lets users publish entries or let customers subscribe to them. The customer-requests docs cover tracking feedback, not notifying customers about releases.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can let customers subscribe to email updates when new changelog entries are published
